text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Show gross order revenue (order total) and order count by location over time by month, so revenue decline per location can be seen; the causal \"why\" and the investment recommendation are not something the project holds.","measures":[{"ref":"metric:orders.order_total","alias":"gross_revenue"},{"ref":"metric:orders.orders","alias":"order_count"}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"entity:orders.location","role":"key"},{"ref":"dimension:orders.ordered_at","role":"time","grain":"month"}],"display":["dimension:locations.location_name"],"filters":[],"ordering":{"ref":"dimension:orders.ordered_at","direction":"asc"},"expectedShape":"trend","unresolved":[{"clause":"why is our revenue down","options":[],"material":true,"question":"The project holds revenue figures by location and month but no causal drivers; which comparison period defines 'down' (e.g. this month vs last month, this year vs last year)?"},{"clause":"which region should we invest in","options":[],"material":true,"question":"An investment recommendation is not a governed measure; should I rank locations by revenue growth instead?"},{"clause":"revenue","options":["metric:orders.order_total","metric:order_item.revenue"],"material":true,"question":"Do you mean gross order revenue including tax (order_total) or pretax product revenue from order items?"}],"provenance":{"metric:orders.order_total":"q:revenue","metric:orders.orders":"q:revenue down","entity:orders.location":"q:by region","dimension:locations.location_name":"q:by region","dimension:orders.ordered_at":"q:revenue down"}}
